description: A white tray-like base sits on the green tablecloth with two tall white rectangular posts standing on it, and a couple of small circular recesses near the corners. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the top of the left post (left-hand object), wiggles it slightly, then lifts it straight up and away, carrying it leftward and setting it down on the table, while the right hand stays near the front edge of the base to steady it without picking anything up.
